webhook.title: Push Webhook
webhook.desc: When an alert fires, besides the in-page toast, system notification and sound, the server also POSTs a JSON payload to this webhook URL, auto-adapting to ServerChan / WeCom / Feishu bot formats (custom endpoints receive {{payload}}) for mobile push.

custom.name: Your own service
steps: Enter any publicly reachable http(s) URL. The server POSTs {{payload}} as JSON with a 5-second timeout

ftqq.name: ServerChan
steps: Open sct.ftqq.com and sign in with WeChat QR
Go to the SendKey page and copy your key
Paste https://sctapi.ftqq.com/YOURKEY.send into the input above and click Save
Click Send test — the Fangtang official account on WeChat receives a test message

wecom.name: WeCom group bot
steps: In the target WeCom group: right-click the group name → Add group bot → New, name it anything
Paste it into the input above and click Save
Click Send test — the group receives a test alert

feishu.name: Feishu custom bot
steps: Target Feishu group → Settings → Group bots → Add "Custom bot"
In security settings pick "Custom keywords" and enter the keyword 预警
Copy the generated webhook URL, paste it above and Save
Click Send test — the group receives a test alert
